items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: he says I don’t mean Wayne King.

ctx.x: Okay. So your time was in a sense a little more valuable too. To give up a minute twenty for someone talking.

Oh yeah. But nevertheless I just felt this was such a characteristic of the guy, and we did the same thing, because if you can remember back before the CD, there was side one and there was side two. And since one might be marked one, your second most important spot on an LP, and for audience attention but more particularly for disc jockey attention, was the first tune on the second side. See that no longer exists now when old LPs are translated into CDs, that’s just something in the middle. But we actually were…
It’s interesting that both of those tunes are 6/8 feels. Who would expect?
